verdict.rationale: Cognee automatically extracts entities/relationships into a knowledge graph, offers an `.improve` operation that enriches the graph with new inferred connections, an intelligent `recall()` that auto-selects retrieval strategy, and a CLI `report` command that generates a 'Graph Insight Report' describing what the data contains — all first-party documented AI-generated insight features. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality (community benchmarks are self-reported by founders) and clearer evidence of proactive 'suggestions' beyond retrieval/reporting.
